title: Upstream 1:1 prep — Luca & Mira
body:
Context: Mira recently moved off the serving runtime rewrite and is onboarding to the request router workstream. This 1:1 should be ~30 minutes: quick sync, unblock check, and small career touchpoint. Keep it engineering-focused but leave 5 minutes for personal check-in.

Top goals for this meeting:
- Surface any immediate blockers for router integration (latency tests, proto compatibility).
- Confirm next two-week deliverables and what good looks like.
- Align on runbook ownership and on-call handoff timing.
- Coach on prioritization between technical debt and greenfield tasks.
- Career pulse: stretch area and visibility plan.

Suggested agenda (30m):
1) Quick mood / context (2-3m) — ask: how are you feeling about the new codebase?
2) Blockers & fast wins (8-10m) — concrete asks: any PRs waiting review? infra tickets? CI flakes?
3) Priorities & trade-offs (8-10m) — decide Y/N on switching focus to performance baseline first vs shipping feature.
4) Career & growth (5m) — short-term skill to develop and concrete visibility step.
5) Commitments & actions (2-3m) — summarize next steps and owners.

Prep notes / things to surface to Mira:
- Latency regression tests: infra flagged a 12% p99 jump on staging after last merge (INF-1189). Need her sanity-check on whether router change could be the cause.
- PR queue: repo/platform#842 is assigned to Mira but missing integration tests — offer reviewer bandwidth or pair to unblock.
- On-call: propose Mira as secondary for router week of 9/20; confirm she’s comfortable and has runbook access.
- Technical debt trade-off: we have a backlog card to remove legacy request-shim; estimate ~3 days if we freeze feature work.

Coaching prompts (use if conversation stalls):
- If they say they’re stuck: "What is the smallest experiment that gives signal in the next 48 hours?"
- If they push too many priorities: "Which of these two outcomes would save the team the most time next sprint?"
- On ambiguity: "What's the riskiest assumption here and how can we test it cheaply?"

Draft language for sensitive asks:
- For asking reviewer help: "I'm blocked on integration tests for #842; could you spare 60–90m to pair on the failing CI job this week?"
- For escalating infra regressions: "Staging p99 increased by ~12% after change X; I'm triaging now but want to flag in case we need rollback. Recommend: triage tau, run bisection, escalate if not resolved by EOD."

Action items (to capture at end of 1:1):
action_items: Mira: isolate the staging benchmark that reproduces p99 regression and post results in #perf by 2026-09-13
Luca: allocate 2 reviewer hours this week to help unblock repo/platform#842
Mira: confirm on-call secondary availability for week of 2026-09-20 by 2026-09-12
Luca: add short visibility bullet to weekly eng update about router rollout plan
Mira: pick one technical-debt card to de-scope or re-estimate before next sprint planning
